title: The Jukebox
body: Join a voice channel and use its embedded chat. /play searches YouTube Music, YouTube and SoundCloud. Supported Spotify and Apple Music references resolve metadata, then require a confident playable match or your explicit choice. Direct audio is optional. The controller distinguishes pending requests from confirmed playback.

fields.query_or_link: Search for a song or artist, or provide a supported track or playlist link. Ambiguous recording matches require your choice.
fields.time: Seek within the current supported recording.
fields.position: Use the current queue or playlist position.
fields.name: Your own playlist name.

steps: Join a voice channel and open its embedded text chat.
Search with /play and choose an available authorized recording.
Confirm duplicates when prompted; check pending versus confirmed playback on the controller.
Skip your own track, use DJ authority, or vote with eligible listeners. Previous, Replay and Seek require the current requester or a DJ.
Save your own playlists. Deleting a playlist does not remove tracks already queued.
DJs include the configured staff tiers and optional dedicated DJ role. Autoplay chooses another available recording by the same artist; unavailable matches leave the jukebox idle.
The pinned player refreshes without reposting each change. After an unexpected voice departure, use /music join to resume; a process restart recovers the saved queue.
